passages.note: Nay on third reading of a single-subject constitutional marriage-definition amendment; rejects rung 5 but does not separate rungs 1-4.

passages.provision_quote: Only a marriage between one (1) man and one (1) woman shall be valid or recognized as a marriage in Indiana.
passages.note: Operative text of the amendment he voted against; a No on a ban shows only the side opposing rung 5.
Bill details page for the same instrument; does not name Pierce and prints only a digest, not the operative text.

rows.reasoning: Pierce voted Nay on HJR 3 (2014), whose operative text reads "Only a marriage between one (1) man and one (1) woman shall be valid or recognized as a marriage in Indiana." Opposing that ban rules out the rung to "make same-sex marriage illegal and define marriage as only between one man and one woman", but it does not show which of the other rungs (full equality with anti-discrimination protection, equal marriage, marriage with a religious carve-out, or civil unions) he holds.
